claims.text: Interpolate before filtering `query.expr`, otherwise template-only queries that resolve to an empty expression can reach the shard-splitting path and crash `runSplitQuery()`
The applyTemplateVariables added at the two entry points doesn't replace the downstream call, so the same query gets interpolated 2-3 times.

The two new tests mock templateSrv.replace to substitute $__auto with 5m and assert expr === 'count_over_time({a="b"}[5m])'. Does the real applyTemplateVariables actually substitute $__auto in production?
toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5) doesn't explain how the number 5 was derived.

Test asserts call count (toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5)) which encodes the multi-pass symptom rather than the intended behavior - any future optimization removing redundant calls will break the test even though behavior improves. Should assert what the query looks like after interpolation instead
The fix should remove the applyTemplateVariables call from runSplitQuery and runShardSplitQuery, relying solely on the existing call in DataSourceWithBackend.query()

Double application of applyTemplateVariables/ad hoc filters: applyTemplateVariables is called upfront, then again in DataSourceWithBackend.query() which unconditionally calls it. For parsed log queries with ad hoc filters, addFilterAsLabelFilter has no duplicate-detection guard, causing duplicate label filters like `| env=`prod` | env=`prod``
The applyTemplateVariables method is called with request.filters as the third parameter, but this parameter is not used in the corresponding test setup.
Test assertion expects template interpolation once per shard, but the code now interpolates each target only once before splitting - assertion count should be 1 instead of 5

The new applyTemplateVariables call in runSplitQuery (line 298) causes ad-hoc filters to be duplicated on every split query, because DataSourceWithBackend.query() also calls applyTemplateVariables downstream, and addAdHocFilters unconditionally appends filter clauses without deduplication

Call-count expectation in test at line 112 expects 5 calls to datasource.applyTemplateVariables, but runShardSplitQuery only calls applyTemplateVariables once per initial target (this test has one target), so the expectation should be changed to 1
The split request now carries interpolated targets into trackGroupedQueries, where legendFormat is reported without obfuscation — does analytics expect the pre- or post-interpolation value?
For shard-split queries, applyTemplateVariables is called three times (runShardSplitQuery + runSplitQuery + DataSourceWithBackend.query), tripling the ad-hoc filters

Triple application of applyTemplateVariables in shard-split path: runShardSplitQuery calls applyTemplateVariables, then dispatches to runSplitQuery which calls it again, then datasource.runQuery calls DataSourceWithBackend.query() which calls it a third time, causing ad hoc filters to be added multiple times per sub-request
The two entry points now run the same three-step pipeline, but their filter order is reversed.

Tests don't catch this bug because they mock datasource.runQuery so super.query() and its applyTemplateVariables call never execute, and the mock applyTemplateVariables does an idempotent string replace that hides the duplication
